features.title: Instalment plans, *without* the missed payments.
features.body: Set up a plan in a few clicks, follow every instalment and see at a glance what is still due.

items.title: Instalment plans
items.body: Deposit, number of instalments and start date: the schedule builds itself.

items.title: Schedule per customer

items.title: Balance due
items.body: The amount owed is recalculated with each payment.

features.title: Overdue payments, *chased* on time.
features.body: Tavio spots late instalments and prepares the WhatsApp reminder to send to your customer.

items.title: Overdue list

items.title: WhatsApp reminder

items.title: Reminder history

items.title: Algerian VAT

items.title: Accounting entries

items.title: Human resources

items.title: Algerian VAT

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Your data is hosted in Europe, or on your own servers with the on-premise option. You remain the owner of your data.

items.question: Can I use Tavio in Arabic?
items.answer: Yes. The interface is available in Arabic, French and English, with a right-to-left layout for Arabic.

items.question: How many users can I add?
items.answer: It depends on your plan, from 1 to 25 users.

items.question: Are the invoices compliant in Algeria?
items.answer: Tavio applies Algerian VAT and provides NIF and RC fields. Have your accountant validate the invoice template.

items.question: Can I install Tavio on my own servers?
items.answer: Yes. The on-premise offer keeps your data in Algeria, with Docker installation, backups and support.
